policies.title: Refundable vs non-refundable rates
policies.content: Each cabin is offered on two rates. A refundable rate costs a little more and lets you cancel free of charge up to the deadline shown for that rate; a non-refundable rate is cheaper but is not refunded if you cancel. The exact free-cancellation deadline and any charge are shown for your dates during booking and in your confirmation. If you are unsure which rate you booked or want to change dates, contact us by phone or email and we will help.

policies.title: Booking and payment
policies.content: Booking and payment are completed in the Osada Hygge reservation system. Prices are shown per night in Polish zloty (PLN) and cover the whole cabin. The amount due at booking, the balance, and any security deposit are shown at the final step and in your confirmation. For questions about payment, contact us by phone or email.

policies.title: Changes and rebooking
policies.content: Moving your dates is free up to 48 hours before check-in — you pay only the difference if the new nights cost more (weekends and holidays are priced higher). Inside 48 hours, one date change per booking is allowed subject to availability and any rate difference. Switching to a different cabin is treated as a date change as long as the new cabin is available for your nights.

policies.title: Check-in and check-out
policies.content: Check-in is from 15:00 and check-out is by 11:00. Directions to Osada Hygge and check-in details are sent before arrival. Early check-in or late check-out can sometimes be arranged depending on the day's bookings — just ask.

policies.title: What's included in every cabin
policies.content: Each cabin is booked whole and comes with a full kitchen, bed linen and towels, free Wi-Fi, underfloor heating, free parking by the cabin, and a private terrace. Fika and Lagom add a private jacuzzi on the terrace. Firewood for the fire pit and a starter set of coffee and tea are provided. Cots and high chairs are available on request at no charge.

policies.title: Bringing your dog
policies.content: Well-behaved dogs are welcome in every cabin at no extra charge — Osada Hygge sits inside the Gostynin-Wloclawek forest, so it's a great base for walks. Please keep dogs off the beds and jacuzzi, clean up on the grounds, and never leave a dog alone in the cabin. Let us know at booking how many dogs are coming so we can leave out bowls and a blanket.

policies.title: Guests and occupancy
policies.content: The rate covers the cabin's stated capacity: Fika, Lagom, Gron and Hyggelig sleep up to four, and Lykke sleeps two. Occupancy above the stated number is not permitted for safety and insurance reasons. Events and parties are not allowed — Osada Hygge is a quiet forest retreat, not an event venue.

policies.title: Getting to Osada Hygge
policies.content: Osada Hygge is at Krzywie 44D, 09-500 Gostynin, in the Gostynin-Wloclawek Landscape Park — roughly a two-hour drive from Warsaw and under an hour from Plock. There is free parking beside each cabin, and forest and lake are on the doorstep. Exact directions are sent before arrival. Phone: +48 691 661 677, e-mail: hej@osadahygge.pl.
